title: Watchfulness
definition: Watchfulness is spiritual alertness against sin, temptation, false teaching, discouragement, and neglect of prayer.
summary: Watchfulness is alert, prayerful readiness against temptation, false teaching, spiritual drift, and Christ's return.
christFocus: Jesus Christ commands His disciples to watch and pray as they wait for Him and resist temptation.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on spiritual alertness. Watchfulness refuses sleepy discipleship by paying attention to danger, weakness, opportunity, and the coming Lord. It is sober without being paranoid because it trusts Christ while staying awake.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because drift often happens gradually. Temptation, error, and complacency grow when believers stop watching and praying. Watchfulness helps the Church remain faithful in a distracting and spiritually dangerous world.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask where you are most prone to drift when tired, isolated, or comfortable. Watch and pray before temptation becomes a crisis. Encourage others gently when you see warning signs.
